faq.title: Questions you are about to ask

items.q: Do you need my SAT credentials?
items.a: No. You upload the XML files you already download every month. There is no field for an e.firma or a tax portal password anywhere in the product, and there never will be.

items.q: Will my clients see the Forcelis brand?
items.a: No. From the Professional plan up, the deliverables carry your brand.

items.q: Is Forcelis going to sell accounting to my clients?
items.a: No. Forcelis does not do accounting and does not file returns. The relationship with your client is yours.

items.q: What happens to my clients' data?
items.a: Each company is isolated at four independent layers, the last one enforced by the database itself. A company only enters the anonymous benchmark with its own signed authorization.

items.q: Can I start with only a few clients?
items.a: Yes. The Professional plan covers up to 10 companies, and each extra company is added to your monthly bill.

closing.title: See it against one of your own clients.
closing.body: Request a demo tailored to your business needs. If you can, bring the XML of a company you already serve.
